paths.title: Adept of Whispers
paths.description: Keep your voice low and let your prayers do the shouting. Spending an action point sharpens your aim with divine powers and widens your blasts and bursts for a turn, while a quiet presence improves Stealth, Insight and Intimidate at the cost of social grace. Later you can raise your voice for a wider critical range and harder-to-shake effects, accepting a daze in return. Your powers deafen and push back foes, mend an ally with a murmur, and finish with a whispered curse.

paths.title: Angelic Aspect
paths.description: Let divine energy remake you as something part mortal and part angel. Resistance to necrotic and radiant damage toughens you, and an action point gives you wings to fly across the battlefield with a sturdier defense. At higher levels, attackers who swing at you while you are unbloodied suffer a penalty. Your powers sprout blades that slow nearby foes, grant protection against nearly any damage type, and culminate in a pillar of cold fire that scorches everything around you.

paths.title: Arbiter of Forgotten Justice
paths.description: Carry a fallen god's justice into battle, answering an ally's collapse with swift retribution. When a friend is bloodied or dropped, an action point lets you respond at once with sharper attacks, and your critical hits heal an ally nearby. Radiant attacks score critical hits more often, especially against demons and devils. Your powers burn and topple enemies in a burst of light, interrupt an attack to spare an ally at the price of a healing surge, and wrap a foe in a searing shroud of radiance.

paths.title: Devoted Orator
paths.description: Make your voice a weapon, booming across the battlefield with thunderous authority. Your Intelligence can stand in for Charisma when you persuade, and an action point lets you push or pull every nearby enemy. Your close attacks can carry extra thunder damage and a shove, while your powers send foes fleeing in fear, leave an attacker vulnerable to thunder, and daze and deafen a crowd with an oration you can repeat on your next turn.

paths.title: Divine Hand
paths.description: Become a fearless instrument of your god's wrath, terrifying enemies as you stride across the field. An action point frees you from slowing and immobilizing effects and can pin your target in place with fear, while a bonus against fear leaves you hard to rattle yourself. Frightened foes struggle to hit you, and your powers isolate the craven, project a zone of dread that makes approaching you costly, and send enemies sprawling and dazed.

paths.title: Divine Philosopher
paths.description: Win fights with study and insight, treating every foe as a puzzle to be solved. You can reroll an attack made with an action point, borrow an at-will divine attack from another class as an encounter power, and gain bonuses against creatures you identify with a successful monster knowledge check. Your powers lower enemy resistances, let you seize the initiative when you recognize an enemy's origin, and weaken and expose foes whose nature you have studied.

paths.title: Flame of Hope
paths.description: Kindle courage in your companions with fire that heals and burns in equal measure. Allies near you save more easily while you are unbloodied, and an action point attack lets you and everyone close by hit your targets harder thanks to your Intelligence. Your second wind releases a wave of fire and radiance that scorches nearby enemies and shields nearby allies with temporary hit points. Your powers mark enemies for your allies, blind an attacker, and root foes in place while mending your friends.

paths.title: Hammer of Vengeance
paths.description: Be the hammer your god swings at the enemy, answering every attack with a thunderous reprisal. Enemies close to you save poorly while you are unbloodied, and an action point makes anyone who strikes you or a friend pay in thunder damage. Critical hits leave their target dazed. Your powers brand a foe with explosive retribution, call allies to your side with a teleporting shout, and lay down a ward of thunder that strikes again whenever a chosen ally is attacked.

paths.title: Keeper of the Nine
paths.description: Guard the world's buried seals and punish those who would break them. An action point leaves one target vulnerable to all damage, your close powers can shatter the ground around you into difficult terrain, and your bursts grow wider when you are bloodied. Your prayers drive enemies away so allies can make opportunity attacks with a bonus, teleport you out of danger when you are hurt, and conjure a glyph of thunder that stuns and then dazes everything it touches.

paths.title: Speaker of the Word
paths.description: Speak a single terrible Word in a whisper and let its syllables reshape the fight. You gain a bonus to Charisma-based skill checks, an action point lets you reroll a die and take the better result, and each Word power leaves you with a bonus to attack rolls until the end of your following turn. Your powers blind and deafen enemies while cloaking allies in radiance, guide friends across the field with slides, and unleash the complete Word as ruinous psychic damage that dooms a target's next saving throw.

paths.title: Stonecaller
paths.description: Wake the stone of the world and make it fight beside you. An action point sends an earthquake rolling outward, turning the ground to difficult terrain and knocking down creatures you hit within it, while sure footing lets you resist falling prone and ignore rubble. Later, tremorsense lets you feel enemies through the ground. Your powers raise jagged fangs of rock, steady you or an ally against forced movement, and conjure a black obelisk that weakens, pulls in, and immobilizes your foes.

paths.title: Zealous Demagogue
paths.description: Rally allies with righteous conviction and bend the minds of enemies who listen too closely. Diplomacy, Insight and Intimidate improve, allies who can see you resist charm and fear, and an action point showers nearby friends with temporary hit points and a bonus to attack rolls. While you are bloodied, your example inspires every ally who can see you. Your powers send an ally charging, swap an ally into the line of fire in your place, and seize control of an enemy for a few moments.
